raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 3, each delivery includes transactions about 2–3 days old. The hard-coded rule `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours` in silver_transactions silently drops these unique, POSTED transactions, so silver and every gold table undercount. The monitors expect every posted transaction that was delivered to reach silver, and txn_id is unique, so these rows are late arrivals, not duplicates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= ingest_ts"}}
